name: Fungal Transformation
body:
School: transmutation; Level fungomancer 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a rare mushroom)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target willing creature touched
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You transform the target into a fungal version of themselves. The target gains the plant type, immunity to mind-affecting effects, poison, sleep effects, paralysis, and stunning. They also gain low-light vision and DR 5/slashing. However, they become vulnerable to effects that specifically harm plants.
